Patching only DAY/MONTH/YEAR would break DAY(DATE(...)) for January-February 1900, so the fix belongs in IronCalc's date numbering (DATE, parsing, formatting, XLSX), proposed upstream (F.14). Serials from 61 (1900-03-01) agree.
